name: pandas-ai

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. PandasAI defaults to OpenAI for natural-language → pandas code.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed code generation.

DATA_DIR.description: Directory of CSV/XLSX/Parquet files to expose as queryable tables. Defaults to ./data.

PANDASAI_SAVE_CHARTS.description: Set to '1' to persist generated chart PNGs to OUTPUT_DIR. Off by default.

notes: Natural-language → pandas code over local tabular files. ADVISOR tier — generated code runs in a sandboxed exec scope, but pandas can still read the entire DATA_DIR; outputs are previewed before commit. License is custom (NOASSERTION on GitHub) — review the LICENSE file before redistributing.
